audience: small firms that run CRM, projects, hours and invoices in Simplicate

useCases.title: Find organizations and their people
useCases.text: List organizations with filters such as name, then read one organization and the persons linked to it.

useCases.title: Review open sales deals
useCases.text: List sales deals and open one to read its status, value and organization.

useCases.title: Check unpaid invoices
useCases.text: List invoices filtered by status, then open one invoice to read its lines and totals.

useCases.title: Read hours booked on projects
useCases.text: List hours registrations filtered by employee, and projects filtered by name, with the employees of the account.

useCases.title: Add an organization and a timeline note
useCases.text: Create an organization, then add a timeline note to it. The note is written in the name of the signed-in user.
